testPlanTemplates.TP-NON-NORMATIVE-ATTESTATION: Record that this history, example, feedback or reference-navigation span adds no independent behavioral requirement; cited normative sections remain separately indexed.
testPlanTemplates.TP-JAVAC-DIAGNOSTICS: Use the pinned external javac 21/25 to compile accepted and rejected source forms; record diagnostics by required outcome, and retain emitted class hashes.
testPlanTemplates.TP-COMPILE-AND-RUN: Compile positive/negative source forms with the pinned external javac, then compare specified behavior of its unchanged output on native Java, Node and Chromium.
testPlanTemplates.TP-VM-BEHAVIOR: Create valid and negative class/runtime fixtures, check specified values/errors/side effects against the native oracle and the text on Node and Chromium; do not demand unspecified diagnostics.
testPlanTemplates.TP-CLASS-FORMAT: Use genuine javac 21/25 output plus separately labeled malformed class controls; check acceptance and specified format/verification errors on Node and Chromium.
testPlanTemplates.TP-LINKAGE: Use separately compiled/evolved classes and module boundaries; test specified resolution, initialization and error caching on Node and Chromium.
testPlanTemplates.TP-OPCODE: Exercise the instruction with boundary values, stack/local effects and specified failures in genuine or explicitly generated class files on Node and Chromium.
testPlanTemplates.TP-OPCODE-TABLE: Verify the JVMS opcode-byte-to-mnemonic table against decoder dispatch and the corresponding chapter 6 instruction contracts, including reserved values.
testPlanTemplates.TP-MEMORY-MODEL: Use litmus tests for required/forbidden outcomes, monitor and ordering invariants; never require one nondeterministic schedule or a fixed timing.
testPlanTemplates.TP-BINARY-COMPAT: Compile caller and library separately, evolve only the library, retain caller bytes and compare specified linkage/behavior on native Java, Node and Chromium.
testPlanTemplates.TP-MODULE-BOUNDARY: Compile module declarations/imports with pinned javac, then test runtime resolution, readability, exports, opens and services with positive and negative cases on each host.
testPlanTemplates.TP-FINAL-ONLY-BOUNDARY: Record final versus preview scope for this edition; retain disabled-preview admission/diagnostic controls without claiming preview execution.
testPlanTemplates.TP-EXCLUSION-AUDIT: Record the exact preview/incubator/JDK-specific feature and edition excluded from the final-only profile; do not count it as a final Java SE success.
